Before connecting WhatsApp
There are two ways to do it. The WhatsApp Business Platform (Meta Cloud API, or a provider such as 360dialog or Twilio) is the supported one: a verified business number, inbound messages delivered to this system by webhook, replies sent back through the API. The other way is a library that drives WhatsApp Web with a logged-in phone — open-wa, whatsapp-web.js, Baileys. It is quicker to start and it breaks WhatsApp's terms of service; numbers used this way get banned, and the ban lands on the number your clients already message.

The rule that shapes the whole design either way: outside 24 hours since the client's last message, only pre-approved template messages may be sent. Free-form replies and automated follow-ups are allowed only inside that window.
